profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 43 (Digital Realty missing-address campaign): added an address matched via a same-pattern generic listing name, corroborated by the operators own building specific page and independent trade coverage of this buildings well known flagship status.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Digital Realty is a publicly traded data center real estate investment trust. This session sourced two acquisitions that explain building names appearing across this operators rows in this registry. Per Data Center Dynamics trade press, Digital Realty completed a 7.8 billion dollar all-stock merger with DuPont Fabros Technology on September 15, 2017, adding 12 facilities concentrated in Ashburn, Virginia, which is why several Ashburn buildings in this registry still carry DuPont Fabros own ACC, meaning Ashburn Corporate Campus, naming convention. Separately, per Data Center Knowledge trade press, Digital Realty acquired the East Coast data center operations of AboveNet Inc. on October 2, 2006, for 40 million dollars, including a leased facility at 8100 Boone Boulevard, Vienna, Virginia, which is this registrys 8100 Boone Boulevard row. This specific row, a generically named Digital Realty Data Center in Atlanta, GA, matches a Cloud and Colocation listing using the same generic Digital Realty Atlanta Data Center name, which gives 56 Marietta Street, Atlanta, GA 30303. The operators own site separately identifies this same 56 Marietta Street building as ATL13, and Baxtel and the Center for Land Use Interpretation both describe it as Atlantas Carrier Hotel, a singular, well known flagship downtown facility, distinct from the operators newer Austell, GA ATL11 campus already tracked separately in this registry.
